Read both datasets

SILC <- read_xlsx("C:/Users/PC/Documents/Estágio e Dissertação/SILC_Final.xlsx")

GEM <- read_xlsx("C:/Users/PC/Documents/Estágio e Dissertação/GEM_final.xlsx")

Convert again to categorical formats

SILC

SILC$Age <- factor(SILC$Age, 
                   levels = c("18-24","25-34","35-44","45-54","55-64")
)

SILC$Gender <- factor(SILC$Gender, levels = c("Male","Female"))

SILC$HhSize <- factor(SILC$HhSize, 
                      levels = c("1", "2", "3+"))

SILC$CountryBirth <- factor(SILC$CountryBirth,
  levels = c("Luxembourg", "Portugal", 
             "Other countries in Europe", "Rest of the World")
)

SILC$ParentsCountryBirth <- factor(SILC$ParentsCountryBirth,
  levels =  c("Luxembourg", "Abroad")
)

SILC$EducationalLevel = factor(SILC$EducationalLevel, 
                               levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"))


SILC$ActivityStatus <- factor(SILC$ActivityStatus,
                                levels = c("Employed", "Unemployed", "Retired", "Inactive"))

SILC$EmploymentStatus = factor(SILC$EmploymentStatus, 
                              levels = c("Self-employed", 
                                         "Employee", 
                                         "Others"))

SILC$FullPartTime = factor(SILC$FullPartTime, 
                                levels = c("Full-time", "Part-time", "Others"))

SILC <- as.data.frame(SILC)

GEM

GEM$Age <- factor(GEM$Age, levels = c("18-24","25-34","35-44","45-54","55-64"))

GEM$Gender <- factor(GEM$Gender, levels= c("Male","Female"))

GEM$HhSize = factor(GEM$HhSize, 
                      levels = c("1", "2", "3+"))

GEM$CountryBirth <- factor(GEM$CountryBirth,
  levels = c( "Luxembourg", "Portugal", 
             "Other countries in Europe", "Rest of the World")
)

GEM$ParentsCountryBirth <- factor(GEM$ParentsCountryBirth,
  levels = c( "Luxembourg", "Abroad")
)

GEM$EducationalLevel <- factor(GEM$EducationalLevel, 
                               levels = c("Low", "Medium","High")
                               )

GEM$ActivityStatus <- factor(GEM$ActivityStatus, 
                             levels=c("Employed","Unemployed","Retired","Inactive"))

GEM$EmploymentStatus <- factor(GEM$EmploymentStatus,
                            levels=c("Self-employed","Employee","Others")
)

GEM$FullPartTime <- factor(GEM$FullPartTime, 
                           levels = c("Full-time", "Part-time", "Others"))

GEM <- GEM %>% mutate(
  TotalEntreperneurialActivity= case_when(
    TotalEntreperneurialActivity == "No" ~ 0,
    TotalEntreperneurialActivity == "Yes" ~ 1
))

GEM <- GEM %>%
  mutate(
    Opportunity = case_when(
      Opportunity == "Agree" ~ 1,
      Opportunity == "Otherwise" ~ 0
    ),
    Fear = case_when(
      Fear == "Agree" ~ 1,
      Fear == "Otherwise" ~ 0
    ),
    Skill = case_when(
      Skill == "Agree" ~ 1,
      Skill == "Otherwise" ~ 0
    ),
    Start = case_when(
      Start == "Agree" ~ 1,
      Start == "Otherwise" ~ 0
    )
  )

GEM <- as.data.frame(GEM)

Calibrating SILC

Data from LUX

PopAgeSex <- read_xlsx("C:/Users/PC/Documents/Estágio e Dissertação/PopAgeSex.xlsx", sheet="Sheet1")

PopAgeSex_long <- PopAgeSex %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Males, Females),
    names_to = "Gender",
    values_to = "Pop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = ifelse(Gender == "Males", "Male", "Female"),
    Gender = factor(Gender, levels = levels(GEM$Gender)),
    Age    = factor(Age,    levels = levels(GEM$Age))
  )

Calibrate SILC weights using ‘calib’

Xs <- model.matrix(~ Age:Gender - 1, data = SILC)
X_names <- colnames(Xs)

PopAgeSex_long <- PopAgeSex_long %>%
  mutate(
    Cell = paste0("Age", Age, ":Gender", Gender)
  )

tot_pop <- setNames(PopAgeSex_long$Pop, PopAgeSex_long$Cell)
tot_pop <- tot_pop[colnames(Xs)]

stopifnot(all(names(tot_pop) == X_names))

g_weights <- calib(
  Xs = Xs,
  d = SILC$PersonalWeight,
  total = tot_pop,
  method = "raking"
)

SILC$CalibratedWeight <- SILC$PersonalWeight * g_weights

Evaluate differences in the weights

SILC %>%
  summarise(
    Min_Original = min(PersonalWeight),
    Max_Original = max(PersonalWeight),
    Min_Calibrated = min(CalibratedWeight),
    Max_Calibrated = max(CalibratedWeight)
  )
##   Min_Original Max_Original Min_Calibrated Max_Calibrated
## 1     1.146652     4172.597       1.052007       4526.688
SILC %>%
  mutate(Diff = CalibratedWeight - PersonalWeight,
         Ratio = CalibratedWeight / PersonalWeight) %>%
  summarise(
    Min_Ratio = min(Ratio),
    Max_Ratio = max(Ratio),
    Mean_Ratio = mean(Ratio),
    Median_Ratio = median(Ratio)
  )
##   Min_Ratio Max_Ratio Mean_Ratio Median_Ratio
## 1 0.8161553  1.193479   1.030057     1.024706
ggplot(SILC, aes(x = CalibratedWeight / PersonalWeight)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "skyblue") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of the calibration",
       x = "CalibratedWeight / PersonalWeight")

SILC %>%
  group_by(Age, Gender) %>%
  summarise(Weighted = sum(PersonalWeight))
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by Age and Gender.
## ℹ Output is grouped by Age.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(Age, Gender))` for per-operation grouping
##   (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
## # A tibble: 10 × 3
## # Groups:   Age [5]
##    Age   Gender Weighted
##    <fct> <fct>     <dbl>
##  1 18-24 Male     29969.
##  2 18-24 Female   31215.
##  3 25-34 Male     51585.
##  4 25-34 Female   44584.
##  5 35-44 Male     44168.
##  6 35-44 Female   53232.
##  7 45-54 Male     47236.
##  8 45-54 Female   43046.
##  9 55-64 Male     44298.
## 10 55-64 Female   43321.
SILC %>%
  group_by(Age, Gender) %>%
  summarise(Calibrated = sum(CalibratedWeight))
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by Age and Gender.
## ℹ Output is grouped by Age.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(Age, Gender))` for per-operation grouping
##   (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
## # A tibble: 10 × 3
## # Groups:   Age [5]
##    Age   Gender Calibrated
##    <fct> <fct>       <dbl>
##  1 18-24 Male       27644.
##  2 18-24 Female     25476.
##  3 25-34 Male       54308.
##  4 25-34 Female     51470.
##  5 35-44 Male       52713.
##  6 35-44 Female     51811.
##  7 45-54 Male       48403 
##  8 45-54 Female     46699.
##  9 55-64 Male       44100.
## 10 55-64 Female     41563.
SILC %>%
  mutate(Ratio = CalibratedWeight / PersonalWeight) %>%
  filter(Ratio > 3 | Ratio < 0.3)
##  [1] PersonalID          FullPartTime        InterviewMode      
##  [4] EmploymentStatus    HhID                PersonalWeight     
##  [7] Age                 Gender              HhSize             
## [10] HhWeight            CountryBirth        Citizenship        
## [13] EducationalLevel    ActivityStatus      ParentsCountryBirth
## [16] CalibratedWeight    Ratio              
## <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)

Design of the probabilistic sample

silc_design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~HhID + PersonalID,
  weights = ~CalibratedWeight,
  data = SILC
)

Testing IPW

With interaction between Employment and Educational

set.seed(300326)
model_ipw1 <- nonprob(
  selection = ~ Age + Gender + CountryBirth + ParentsCountryBirth + 
                      (EducationalLevel + EmploymentStatus)^2 + HhSize,
  target = ~ TotalEntreperneurialActivity,
  data = GEM,
  svydesign = silc_design,
  method_selection = "logit",
  control_selection = control_sel(est_method="gee", gee_h_fun = 1, penalty = "SCAD"),
  control_inference = control_inf(vars_selection = TRUE)
)
## Warning in theta_h_estimation(R = R, X = X, weights_rand = weights_rand, : Relatively convergent algorithm when fitting selection model by nleqslv,
##                          but user must check if function values are acceptably small.
summary(model_ipw1)
## A nonprob_summary object
##  - call: nonprob(data = GEM, selection = ~Age + Gender + CountryBirth + 
##     ParentsCountryBirth + (EducationalLevel + EmploymentStatus)^2 + 
##     HhSize, target = ~TotalEntreperneurialActivity, svydesign = silc_design, 
##     method_selection = "logit", control_selection = control_sel(est_method = "gee", 
##         gee_h_fun = 1, penalty = "SCAD"), control_inference = control_inf(vars_selection = TRUE))
##  - estimator type: inverse probability weighting
##  - nonprob sample size: 1221 (0.3%)
##  - prob sample size: 3183 (0.7%)
##  - population size: 444187 (fixed: false)

## ----------------------------------------------------------------
##  - sum of IPW weights: 444187

Boxplot

  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma) +

Comparison of IPW results and population data

PopAgeSex_long <- PopAgeSex_long %>%
  mutate(prop_census = Pop / sum(Pop))

ipw_props1 <- sum_ipw_by_age_gender1 %>%
  mutate(prop_ipw1 = total_ipw1 / sum(total_ipw1))

comparison_age_gender1 <- PopAgeSex_long %>%
  left_join(ipw_props1, by = c("Age", "Gender")) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_prop   = prop_ipw1 - prop_census,
    diff_pct_pt = 100 * diff_prop
  )

Comparison between the 2 models

models_list <- list(model_ipw1, model_ipw2)
dfs_list <- list(df_ipw1, df_ipw2)

ipweights <- c("ipw_weight1", "ipw_weight2")

comparison_table <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Model 1: With interaction", 
            "Model 2: Without interactions"),
  Estimate = round(sapply(models_list, function(m) as.numeric(m$output$mean)), 3),
  Std_Error = round(sapply(models_list, function(m) as.numeric(m$output$SE)), 3),
  Max_Weight = round(mapply(function(d, col) max(d[[col]], na.rm = TRUE), dfs_list, ipweights), 2),
  Var_Weights = round(mapply(function(d, col) var(d[[col]], na.rm = TRUE), dfs_list, ipweights), 2)
)

print(comparison_table)
##                           Model Estimate Std_Error Max_Weight Var_Weights
## 1     Model 1: With interaction    0.100     0.014    2497.46    64714.58
## 2 Model 2: Without interactions    0.108     0.016    2275.55    64366.31

             TEA = GEM$TotalEntreperneurialActivity, 
             Model = "Model 1: With interaction"),
             
  data.frame(ipw_weight = df_ipw2$ipw_weight2, 
             TEA = GEM$TotalEntreperneurialActivity, 
             Model = "Model 2: No Interactions"),
)

ggplot(combined_ipw_data, aes(x = ipw_weight, y = TEA)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.2, color = "#4e79a7", height = 0.05) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = TRUE) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  facet_wrap(~ Model, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") + 
  labs(title = "Relationship between IPW Weights and TEA across Models",
       subtitle = "Red line: Linear trend",
       x = "IPW Weight (Log10 Scale)",
       y = "Total Entrepreneurial Activity (TEA)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"))
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

Covariate balance

vars <- c("Age", "Gender", "HhSize", "CountryBirth", 
          "ParentsCountryBirth", "EducationalLevel", "EmploymentStatus")

gem_data <- GEM[, vars]
silc_data <- silc_design$variables[, vars]

gem_data$is_gem <- 1
silc_data$is_gem <- 0

combined_data <- rbind(gem_data, silc_data)

weights_silc <- weights(silc_design)

combined_data$Model1_Int <- c(weights(model_ipw1, type = "selection"), weights_silc)
combined_data$Model2_NoInt <- c(weights(model_ipw2, type = "selection"), weights_silc)

balancetab_multi <- bal.tab(
  is_gem ~ Age + Gender + HhSize + CountryBirth + ParentsCountryBirth + EducationalLevel + EmploymentStatus,
  data = combined_data, 
  weights = c("Model1_Int", "Model2_NoInt"), 
  un = TRUE,         
  stats = "mean.diffs", 
  abs = TRUE,       
  m.threshold = 0.1 
)

print(balancetab_multi)

Weight Sharing

Load whole GEM, change format of variables and filter prob side

GEM_prob <- read_xlsx("C:/Users/PC/Documents/Estágio e Dissertação/GEM_Full.xlsx")

GEM_prob$Age <- factor(GEM_prob$Age, levels = c("18-24","25-34","35-44","45-54","55-64"))

GEM_prob$Gender <- factor(GEM_prob$Gender, levels= c("Male","Female"))

GEM_prob$HhSize = factor(GEM_prob$HhSize, 
                      levels = c("1", "2", "3+"))

GEM_prob$CountryBirth <- factor(GEM_prob$CountryBirth,
  levels = c( "Luxembourg", "Portugal", 
             "Other countries in Europe", "Rest of the World")
)

GEM_prob$ParentsCountryBirth <- factor(GEM_prob$ParentsCountryBirth,
  levels = c( "Luxembourg", "Abroad")
)

GEM_prob$EducationalLevel <- factor(GEM_prob$EducationalLevel, 
                               levels = c("Low", "Medium","High")
                               )

GEM_prob$ActivityStatus <- factor(GEM_prob$ActivityStatus, 
                             levels=c("Employed","Unemployed","Retired","Inactive"))

GEM_prob$EmploymentStatus <- factor(GEM_prob$EmploymentStatus,
                            levels=c("Self-employed","Employee","Unemployed+Inactive")
)

GEM_prob$FullPartTime <- factor(GEM_prob$FullPartTime, 
                           levels = c("Full-time", "Part-time", "Unemployed+Inactive"))

GEM_prob <- GEM_prob %>% mutate(
  TotalEntreperneurialActivity= case_when(
    TotalEntreperneurialActivity == "No" ~ 0,
    TotalEntreperneurialActivity == "Yes" ~ 1
))

GEM_prob <- GEM_prob %>%
  mutate(
    Opportunity = case_when(
      Opportunity == "Agree" ~ 1,
      Opportunity == "Otherwise" ~ 0
    ),
    Fear = case_when(
      Fear == "Agree" ~ 1,
      Fear == "Otherwise" ~ 0
    ),
    Skill = case_when(
      Skill == "Agree" ~ 1,
      Skill == "Otherwise" ~ 0
    ),
    Start = case_when(
      Start == "Agree" ~ 1,
      Start == "Otherwise" ~ 0
    )
  )


GEM_prob <- as.data.frame(GEM_prob)

GEM_prob <- GEM_prob %>% 
  filter(InterviewMode == "Interviewer-based")

Change name of GEM non-probabilistic

GEM_nonprob <- GEM

rm(GEM)

Apply weight sharing method. Uses the IPW 2, no interactions.

N_pop <- 444187

GEM_prob_final <- GEM_prob %>%
  mutate(
    expantion_weight = Weight18_64 * (N_pop / sum(Weight18_64, na.rm = TRUE)),
    shared_weight = expantion_weight / 2,
    Source = "Prob"
  )

GEM_nonprob_final <- GEM_nonprob %>%
  mutate(
    expantion_weight = ipw2 * (N_pop / sum(ipw2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    shared_weight = expantion_weight / 2,
    Source = "Non-Prob"
  )

GEM_nonprob <- GEM_nonprob %>% 
  select(-TEAMale, -TEAFemale)


GEM <- bind_rows(GEM_prob_final, GEM_nonprob_final)

sum(GEM$shared_weight, na.rm = TRUE)
## [1] 444187

Impact of new weights on different variables

mean_table <- GEM_nonprob %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(TotalEntreperneurialActivity, Opportunity, Fear, Skill, Start),
      list(
        `Original Unweighted` = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Weighted IPW 1` = ~ weighted.mean(.x, w = ipw1, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Weighted IPW 2` = ~ weighted.mean(.x, w = ipw2, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}___{.fn}" 
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Variable", "Weight_Type"),
    names_sep = "___",
    values_to = "Mean"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Weight_Type,
    values_from = Mean
  )

print(mean_table)
